arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
transliteration: Innaaa arsalnaa Noohan ilaa qawmihee an anzir qawmaka min qabli any yaatiyahum 'azaabun aleem

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We sent Noah unto his people (saying): Warn thy people ere the painful doom come unto them.
translations.en.yusufali: We sent Noah to his People (with the Command): "Do thou warn thy People before there comes to them a grievous Penalty."
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami telah mengutus Nuh kepada kaumnya (dengan memerintahkan): "Berilah kaummu peringatan sebelum datang kepadanya azab yang pedih",

arabic: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
transliteration: Qaala yaa qawmi innee lakum nazeerum mubeen

translations.en.sahih: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner,
translations.en.pickthall: He said: O my people! Lo! I am a plain warner unto you
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "O my People! I am to you a Warner, clear and open:
translations.id.indonesian: Nuh berkata: "Hai kaumku, sesungguhnya aku adalah pemberi peringatan yang menjelaskan kepada kamu,

arabic: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
transliteration: Ani'udul laaha watta qoohu wa atee'oon

translations.en.sahih: [Saying], 'Worship Allah, fear Him and obey me.
translations.en.pickthall: (Bidding you): Serve Allah and keep your duty unto Him and obey me,
translations.en.yusufali: "That ye should worship Allah, fear Him and obey me:
translations.id.indonesian: (yaitu) sembahlah olehmu Allah, bertakwalah kepada-Nya dan taatlah kepadaku,

arabic: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
transliteration: Yaghfir lakum min zunoobikum wa yu'akhkhirkum ilaaa ajalim musammaa; innaa ajalal laahi izaa jaaa'a laa yu'akhkhar; law kuntum ta'lamoon

translations.en.sahih: Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allah, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew.' "
translations.en.pickthall: That He may forgive you somewhat of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Lo! the term of Allah, when it cometh, cannot be delayed, if ye but knew.
translations.en.yusufali: "So He may forgive you your sins and give you respite for a stated Term: for when the Term given by Allah is accomplished, it cannot be put forward: if ye only knew."
translations.id.indonesian: niscaya Allah akan mengampuni sebagian dosa-dosamu dan menangguhkan kamu sampai kepada waktu yang ditentukan. Sesungguhnya ketetapan Allah apabila telah datang tidak dapat ditangguhkan, kalau kamu mengetahui".

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا
transliteration: Qaala rabbi innee da'awtu qawmee lailanw wa naharaa

translations.en.sahih: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.
translations.en.pickthall: He said: My Lord! Lo! I have called unto my people night and day
translations.en.yusufali: He said: "O my Lord! I have called to my People night and day:
translations.id.indonesian: Nuh berkata: "Ya Tuhanku sesungguhnya aku telah menyeru kaumku malam dan siang,

arabic: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًا
transliteration: Falam yazid hum du'aaa 'eee illaa firaaraa

translations.en.sahih: But my invitation increased them not except in flight.
translations.en.pickthall: But all my calling doth but add to their repugnance;
translations.en.yusufali: "But my call only increases (their) flight (from the Right).
translations.id.indonesian: maka seruanku itu hanyalah menambah mereka lari (dari kebenaran).

arabic: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَـٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًا
transliteration: Wa inee kullamaa da'awtuhum litaghfira lahum ja'alooo asaabi'ahum fee aazaanihim wastaghshaw siyaabahum wa asaarroo wastakbarus tikbaaraa

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! whenever I call unto them that Thou mayst pardon them they thrust their fingers in their ears and cover themselves with their garments and persist (in their refusal) and magnify themselves in pride.
translations.en.yusufali: "And every time I have called to them, that Thou mightest forgive them, they have (only) thrust their fingers into their ears, covered themselves up with their garments, grown obstinate, and given themselves up to arrogance.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya setiap kali aku menyeru mereka (kepada iman) agar Engkau mengampuni mereka, mereka memasukkan anak jari mereka ke dalam telinganya dan menutupkan bajunya (kemukanya) dan mereka tetap (mengingkari) dan menyombongkan diri dengan sangat.

arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا
transliteration: Summa innee da'aw tuhum jihaara

translations.en.sahih: Then I invited them publicly.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! I have called unto them aloud,
translations.en.yusufali: "So I have called to them aloud;
translations.id.indonesian: Kemudian sesungguhnya aku telah menyeru mereka (kepada iman) dengan cara terang-terangan,

arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا
transliteration: Summaa inneee a'lantu lahum wa asrartu lahum israaraa

translations.en.sahih: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! I have made public proclamation unto them, and I have appealed to them in private.
translations.en.yusufali: "Further I have spoken to them in public and secretly in private,
translations.id.indonesian: kemudian sesungguhnya aku (menyeru) mereka (lagi) dengan terang-terangan dan dengan diam-diam,

arabic: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًا
transliteration: Faqultus taghfiroo Rabakam innahoo kaana Ghaffaaraa

translations.en.sahih: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.
translations.en.pickthall: And I have said: Seek pardon of your Lord. Lo! He was ever Forgiving.
translations.en.yusufali: "Saying, 'Ask forgiveness from your Lord; for He is Oft-Forgiving;
translations.id.indonesian: maka aku katakan kepada mereka: 'Mohonlah ampun kepada Tuhanmu, -sesungguhnya Dia adalah Maha Pengampun-,

arabic: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا
transliteration: Yursilis samaaa'a 'alaikum midraaraa

translations.en.sahih: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
translations.en.pickthall: He will let loose the sky for you in plenteous rain,
translations.en.yusufali: "'He will send rain to you in abundance;
translations.id.indonesian: niscaya Dia akan mengirimkan hujan kepadamu dengan lebat,

arabic: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَـٰرًا
transliteration: Wa yumdidkum bi am waalinw wa baneena wa yaj'al lakum Jannaatinw wa yaj'al lakum anhaaraa

translations.en.sahih: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.
translations.en.pickthall: And will help you with wealth and sons, and will assign unto you Gardens and will assign unto you rivers.
translations.en.yusufali: "'Give you increase in wealth and sons; and bestow on you gardens and bestow on you rivers (of flowing water).
translations.id.indonesian: dan membanyakkan harta dan anak-anakmu, dan mengadakan untukmu kebun-kebun dan mengadakan (pula di dalamnya) untukmu sungai-sungai.

arabic: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا
transliteration: Maa lakum laa tarjoona lillaahi waqaaraa

translations.en.sahih: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur
translations.en.pickthall: What aileth you that ye hope not toward Allah for dignity
translations.en.yusufali: "'What is the matter with you, that ye place not your hope for kindness and long-suffering in Allah,-
translations.id.indonesian: Mengapa kamu tidak percaya akan kebesaran Allah?

arabic: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
transliteration: Wa qad khalaqakum at waaraa

translations.en.sahih: While He has created you in stages?
translations.en.pickthall: When He created you by (divers) stages?
translations.en.yusufali: "'Seeing that it is He that has created you in diverse stages?
translations.id.indonesian: Padahal Dia sesungguhnya telah menciptakan kamu dalam beberapa tingkatan kejadian.

arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا
transliteration: Alam taraw kaifa khalaqal laahu sab'a samaawaatin tibaaqaa

translations.en.sahih: Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers
translations.en.pickthall: See ye not how Allah hath created seven heavens in harmony,
translations.en.yusufali: "'See ye not how Allah has created the seven heavens one above another,
translations.id.indonesian: Tidakkah kamu perhatikan bagaimana Allah telah menciptakan tujuh langit bertingkat-tingkat?

arabic: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا
transliteration: Wa ja'alal qamara feehinna nooranw wa ja'alash shamsa siraajaa

translations.en.sahih: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?
translations.en.pickthall: And hath made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?
translations.en.yusufali: "'And made the moon a light in their midst, and made the sun as a (Glorious) Lamp?
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Allah menciptakan padanya bulan sebagai cahaya dan menjadikan matahari sebagai pelita?

arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا
transliteration: Wallaahu ambatakum minal ardi nabaataa

translations.en.sahih: And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.
translations.en.pickthall: And Allah hath caused you to grow as a growth from the earth,
translations.en.yusufali: "'And Allah has produced you from the earth growing (gradually),
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Allah menumbuhkan kamu dari tanah dengan sebaik-baiknya,

arabic: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا
transliteration: Summa yu'eedukum feehaa wa ukhrijukum ikhraajaa

translations.en.sahih: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.
translations.en.pickthall: And afterward He maketh you return thereto, and He will bring you forth again, a (new) forthbringing.
translations.en.yusufali: "'And in the End He will return you into the (earth), and raise you forth (again at the Resurrection)?
translations.id.indonesian: kemudian Dia mengembalikan kamu ke dalam tanah dan mengeluarkan kamu (daripadanya pada hari kiamat) dengan sebenar-benarnya.

arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا
transliteration: Wallaahu ja'ala lakumul arda bisaataa

translations.en.sahih: And Allah has made for you the earth an expanse
translations.en.pickthall: And Allah hath made the earth a wide expanse for you
translations.en.yusufali: "'And Allah has made the earth for you as a carpet (spread out),
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Allah menjadikan bumi untukmu sebagai hamparan,

arabic: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا
transliteration: Litaslukoo minhaa subulan fijaajaa

translations.en.sahih: That you may follow therein roads of passage.' "
translations.en.pickthall: That ye may thread the valley-ways thereof.
translations.en.yusufali: "'That ye may go about therein, in spacious roads.'"
translations.id.indonesian: supaya kamu menjalani jalan-jalan yang luas di bumi itu".

arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
transliteration: Qaala Noohur Robbi innahum 'asawnee wattaba'oo mal lam yazid hu maaluhoo wa waladuhooo illaa khasaara

translations.en.sahih: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.
translations.en.pickthall: Noah said: My Lord! Lo! they have disobeyed me and followed one whose wealth and children increase him in naught save ruin;
translations.en.yusufali: Noah said: "O my Lord! They have disobeyed me, but they follow (men) whose wealth and children give them no increase but only Loss.
translations.id.indonesian: Nuh berkata: "Ya Tuhanku, sesungguhnya mereka telah mendurhakaiku dan telah mengikuti orang-orang yang harta dan anak-anaknya tidak menambah kepadanya melainkan kerugian belaka,

arabic: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا
transliteration: Wa makaroo makran kubbaaraa

translations.en.sahih: And they conspired an immense conspiracy.
translations.en.pickthall: And they have plotted a mighty plot,
translations.en.yusufali: "And they have devised a tremendous Plot.
translations.id.indonesian: dan melakukan tipu-daya yang amat besar".

arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا
transliteration: Wa qaaloo laa tazarunna aalihatakum wa laa tazarunna Waddanw wa laa Suwaa'anw wa laa Yaghoosa wa Ya'ooqa wa Nasraa

translations.en.sahih: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwa' or Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr.
translations.en.pickthall: And they have said: Forsake not your gods. Forsake not Wadd, nor Suwa', nor Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr.
translations.en.yusufali: "And they have said (to each other), 'Abandon not your gods: Abandon neither Wadd nor Suwa', neither Yaguth nor Ya'uq, nor Nasr';-
translations.id.indonesian: Dan mereka berkata: "Jangan sekali-kali kamu meninggalkan (penyembahan) tuhan-tuhan kamu dan jangan pula sekali-kali kamu meninggalkan (penyembahan) wadd, dan jangan pula suwwa', yaghuts, ya'uq dan nasr".

arabic: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَـٰلًا
transliteration: Wa qad adalloo kasee ranw wa laa tazidiz zaalimeena illaa dalaalaa

translations.en.sahih: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."
translations.en.pickthall: And they have led many astray, and Thou increasest the wrong-doers in naught save error.
translations.en.yusufali: "They have already misled many; and grant Thou no increase to the wrong-doers but in straying (from their mark)."
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesudahnya mereka menyesatkan kebanyakan (manusia); dan janganlah Engkau tambahkan bagi orang-orang yang zalim itu selain kesesatan.

arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٔـٰتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًا
transliteration: Mimmaa khateee' aatihim ughriqoo fa udkhiloo Naaran falam yajidoo lahum min doonil laahi ansaaraa

translations.en.sahih: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allah [any] helpers.
translations.en.pickthall: Because of their sins they were drowned, then made to enter a Fire. And they found they had no helpers in place of Allah.
translations.en.yusufali: Because of their sins they were drowned (in the flood), and were made to enter the Fire (of Punishment): and they found- in lieu of Allah- none to help them.
translations.id.indonesian: Disebabkan kesalahan-kesalahan mereka, mereka ditenggelamkan lalu dimasukkan ke neraka, maka mereka tidak mendapat penolong-penolong bagi mereka selain dari Allah.

arabic: وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
transliteration: Wa qaala Noohur Rabbi laa tazar 'alal ardi minal kaafireena daiyaaraa

translations.en.sahih: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.
translations.en.pickthall: And Noah said: My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers in the land.
translations.en.yusufali: And Noah, said: "O my Lord! Leave not of the Unbelievers, a single one on earth!
translations.id.indonesian: Nuh berkata: "Ya Tuhanku, janganlah Engkau biarkan seorangpun di antara orang-orang kafir itu tinggal di atas bumi.

arabic: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا
transliteration: Innaka in tazarhum yudil loo 'ibaadaka wa laa yalidooo illaa faajiran kaffaaraa

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.
translations.en.pickthall: If Thou shouldst leave them, they will mislead Thy slaves and will beget none save lewd ingrates.
translations.en.yusufali: "For, if Thou dost leave (any of) them, they will but mislead Thy devotees, and they will breed none but wicked ungrateful ones.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya jika Engkau biarkan mereka tinggal, niscaya mereka akan menyesatkan hamba-hamba-Mu, dan mereka tidak akan melahirkan selain anak yang berbuat maksiat lagi sangat kafir.

arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا
transliteration: Rabbigh fir lee wa liwaa lidaiya wa liman dakhala baitiya mu'minanw wa lil mu'mineena wal mu'minaati wa laa tazidiz zaalimeena illaa tabaaraa

translations.en.sahih: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."
translations.en.pickthall: My Lord! Forgive me and my parents and him who entereth my house believing, and believing men and believing women, and increase not the wrong-doers in aught save ruin.
translations.en.yusufali: "O my Lord! Forgive me, my parents, all who enter my house in Faith, and (all) believing men and believing women: and to the wrong-doers grant Thou no increase but in perdition!"
translations.id.indonesian: Ya Tuhanku! Ampunilah aku, ibu bapakku, orang yang masuk ke rumahku dengan beriman dan semua orang yang beriman laki-laki dan perempuan. Dan janganlah Engkau tambahkan bagi orang-orang yang zalim itu selain kebinasaan".
